newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan Stanley on IBM Q1.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan Stanley on IBM Q1.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley analyst Steven Milunovich said in a research note on International Business Machines Corp he raised his 1997 earnings estimate to $12.50 per share from $12.30 to reflect a lower tax rate for the company.
-- He said the 1998 estimate remains $14.25 per share and the outperform rating is unchanged.

-- "IBM reported a solid though not spectacular quarter of $2.37 per share versus our $2.25 expectation. Our concerns of weak product sales and margins were realized, but outstanding services growth and expense control caused operating income to hit our number. Management indicated that demand is generally good and Street estimates are reasonable," Milunovich said.
-- The 12-18 month price target is unchanged at $185, "13 times our 1998 estimate."
-- IBM shares were up 10 to 152-3/8 in morning New York Stock Exchange trade, easing off an earlier session high of 154-1/2.
